messages:
deploybot: Hotfix request for search-embed service (img: se-hotfix-2026-04-08). Canary (us-east1-canary) returned intermittent 502/503s on short-batch paths. Requesting expedited approval to push to us-east1-prod only. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/10021

ops-ada: TL;DR on change and blast radius? any config flips?

deploybot: Code-only: add safe-check in batch serialize to avoid nil pointer on empty payloads (PR #6219). Image size +1MB. Target: us-east1 only. No config or infra changes.

pm-ravi: Product ack — customers seeing search failures; we need fast fix. Approve expedited if ops + oncall sign off.

sre-jon: Oncall. Auto-abort policy: abort stage if 502/503 > 5% sustained for 3m OR consumer backlog growth > 2x for 4m. Manual rollback owner: me (sre-jon). Manual rollback command: `releasebot rollback search-embed v6.7.11 --region us-east1`. I will execute if threshold breaches or if I see CPU/memory anomalies. Rollback window open for 30m after deploy.

oncall-bot: sre-jon is oncall for search today (rot: jon-east). Pager window clear for next 35m. Auto-abort hooks active.

ops-ada: infra review: change isolated. I'm +1 after we pin tag and add relnotes. Also request we enable "blast-shield" traffic shaping during rollout to protect downstream queues.

cs-nina: CS standby. Once you provide a 1-line timeline I'll push to affected customers.

releasebot: Draft relnote: "search-embed: guard for empty batch payloads in serializer preventing occasional 502/503 on short-batch requests. Backported to v6.7.12-quickpatch. Pinned tag se-hotfix-2026-04-08 -> v6.7.12-quickpatch." Please confirm pin.

ops-ada: relnote OK. pin tag and include PR #6219 and incident link. Add rollback snippet to relnote.

deploybot: Approvals recorded: pm-ravi (product), ops-ada (infra), sre-jon (oncall). Executing expedited rollout: stages 30% -> 100% with 90s checks, blast-shield enabled. Skipping low-traffic 5% canary due to customer impact.

deploybot: COMMAND: `deploy --svc search-embed --img se-hotfix-2026-04-08 --strategy expedited --region us-east1 --stages 30,100 --check 90s --blast-shield`

releasebot: Release notes pinned to release-logs/2026-04-08-se-quickpatch. Version v6.7.12-quickpatch pinned.

deploybot: stage 30% -> success. Waiting 90s health window.

sre-jon: observing initial drop in 502s, no CPU/Mem spike. continuing.

deploybot: stage 100% -> success. No auto-abort triggered. Metrics: 502/503 down from 17% peak to 0.6% baseline.

cs-nina: CS update: "Hotfix deployed in ~10m; error rate returned to baseline within 5m of full rollout." Sending customer notes now.

pm-ravi: Thanks team. Please attach the short timeline to the incident and mark relnotes with pin.

releasebot: Rollout complete and ticket closed. Follow-up: add short RCA blurb to relnotes and monitor for 1h. No full postmortem needed unless regressions observed.
